sources.entry: Ocular - Simplistic and straightforward budgeting app to track your budget across months and years. (Demo, Source Code) MIT Docker

summary.one_liner: Ocular is a self-hosted budgeting app for tracking budgets across months and years, deployable as a single Docker container.
summary.what_it_does: Ocular is a budgeting application that lets you track budgets over multiple months and years, with support for a custom financial year that can start at any month. It includes a dashboard with statistics and several charts, including a Sankey diagram, plus an all-time overview with analytics. Budgets can be carried over to the next year, and it supports inline expression evaluation when entering amounts. Data can be imported from a Google Sheets annual planner and exported as JSON. The app is available in multiple languages with support for common currencies, offers light and dark themes, can be installed as a Progressive Web App, and includes a privacy mode and keyboard navigation. User management and authentication are handled through the app and a CLI.
use_cases: import budget from Google Sheets planner
carry over budget to next year
how_to_run: Deploy via Docker (see the documentation linked from the README for setup details)
notable: Imports budgets from a Google Sheets annual planner and exports data as JSON
Customizable financial year that can start at any month
Sankey diagram and extensive charts on the dashboard
Privacy mode for use in public places
Installable as a Progressive Web App optimized for mobile
caveats: README is brief and points to external documentation for setup and the demo
Deployment details beyond 'single container via Docker' are not given in the README
